## Overview

**Marcellus Aurelius** — the current Maximus of the Sunforged Legion, the southern barbarian tribe of Kythoria. He is a direct descendant of Cassian Aurelius, the half-elf cleric who served as one of the seven Alliance heroes in the battles against Khar'Zul.

---

## Role

As Maximus, Marcellus leads the Sunforged Legion in its dual mission of military defense and scholarly pursuit. Under his leadership, the Legion's academies continue to educate young scholars from across Kythoria, the Monster Archives continue to catalogue knowledge of the Scourge, and the Legion's forces stand ready to defend the southern frontier. He carries the legacy of his ancestor Cassian — a hero who combined faith, scholarship, and combat in service of the Alliance.
